messages.content: Rewrite plain English in the manner of Hegel's writing, as his nineteenth-century English translators render it. Keep the content exactly: every claim, example and step, in the same order, and add nothing.

Rewrite in Hegel's manner:

The file is gone up for orders, a suspension that mirrors the emptiness of my own stomach. I have walked the length of the city and returned to a house that offers no sustenance, only the quiet tyranny of unpaid debts. Ramesh stands before me, the mediator between my will and the material world, yet I possess only six rupees against a deficit that defies arithmetic. To speak to him now is to acknowledge that my freedom is currently bounded by the ledger, not the spirit.
